Why Leverage Can Magnify Losses as Fast as Gains

Leverage increases the size of a position relative to your capital, which can amplify both gains and losses. More buying power does not create more trading skill. A larger position can make an ordinary market move have a much larger effect on your account. Understanding exposure and position size comes before trying to trade bigger.
